chapters.title: Can Men and Women Be Friends?
A Summer Night
chapters.description: It is the summer of 1940 in Seabrook, South Carolina. A young man named Noah Calhoun is at the town fair with his friend. Across the crowd, he sees a girl he has never seen before. She is laughing, and she looks like she belongs in another world. Noah knows right away that he has to talk to her
